shell.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to collapse

add.comingSoon: Adding expenses, income and transfers is coming soon.

placeholder.transactions: Your expenses, income and transfers will be listed here.
placeholder.reports: Monthly and yearly reports, like your spreadsheet, will be here.
placeholder.family: Invite your family and see your money together here.
placeholder.settings: Your name and report currency will be set here.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

auth.about: Income, expenses and transfers across all your accounts and currencies. Monthly and yearly reports build themselves, for you and your family.
auth.switchLabel: Sign in or create an account

errors.credentials: That email and password don’t match. Check both and try again.
errors.emailUnavailable: We couldn’t create an account with this email.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.google: Google sign-in didn’t work. Try again, or use your email and password.
errors.unknown: That didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.inviteOnly: There’s no Pup Budget account for this sign-in, and new accounts need an invite link. Ask the person who told you about Pup Budget.
errors.inviteGone: This invite link doesn’t work any more. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
errors.blocked: Your access to Pup Budget is turned off. Ask the person who invited you.

wake.note: It sleeps at night; this takes up to a minute.

inviteOnly.title: Pup Budget is invite-only for now
inviteOnly.text: To create an account, you need an invite link. Ask the person who told you about Pup Budget to send you one.
inviteOnly.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in with your email or Google.

invite.until: Create your account to join. This link works once, until {{date}}.
invite.goneTitle: This invite link doesn’t work any more
invite.goneText: It may have been used already, cancelled or expired. Ask the person who sent it for a new one.
invite.goneHint: Already have an account? Sign in with it as usual.

people.lead: Only people you invite can create an account. Everyone here can sign in.

search.label: Search people
search.noneText: Check the spelling, or search by part of the email.

people.beforeInvitesLegend: “Before invites” means the account was made while sign-up was open.

errors.action: That didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.
errors.tooMany: Pick at most {{max}} people at a time.

block.textOne: {{name}} is signed out on every device and can’t sign in. Their data stays, and you can unblock them any time.
block.textMany: They are signed out on every device and can’t sign in. Their data stays, and you can unblock them any time.

delete.textOne: This deletes the account and everything in it: accounts, transactions, categories and settings. It can’t be undone.
delete.textMany: This deletes these accounts and everything in them: accounts, transactions, categories and settings. It can’t be undone.
delete.again: To join again, {{name}} would need a new invite link.

newLink.title: New invite link
newLink.intro: One person can create an account with it within 7 days.
newLink.noteLabel: Who is it for? (optional, only you see it)
newLink.send: Send it in any messenger. It works once, until {{date}}.
newLink.once: Copy it now: Pup Budget can’t show this link again. Lost it? Cancel it and make a new one.

links.lead: A link works once, for 7 days. Pup Budget shows a link only when you make it.
links.noneWaiting: No links are waiting. Make one with New invite link.

rates.notPublished: NBU hasn’t published today’s rates yet. At the rates of {{date}}:
rates.unavailable: Can’t reach the NBU right now. At the rates of {{date}}:
rates.missing: NBU rates aren’t available right now. Try again later.

empty.title: Where is your money?
empty.text: Add each bank card, savings account and pocket of cash, in any currency. Each one becomes a card: solid, tinted, an envelope or plain, as you like.

errors.load: Couldn’t load your accounts. Check the connection and try again.
errors.save: That didn’t go through. Try again in a moment.

archived.title: Archived
archived.text: Not in the totals or the account pickers. Their transactions stay in the lists and reports.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: As you call it: Mono black, Wallet, Dollars at home.
form.currencyFixed: Can’t be changed once the account has transactions.
form.newSourceHint: Only you see it, e.g. Deposit, Crypto wallet, Piggy bank.
form.openingHint: What was on it that day. Below zero for a credit card debt.

end.title: Archive or delete
end.archiveText: Hide it from the list and the totals, keep its history. You can restore it.
end.deleteText: Remove it for good. This can’t be undone.

validation.name: Give the account a name.
validation.bank: Pick your bank or type its name.

picker.none: No currency matches “{{query}}”. NBU publishes rates for about 40 currencies.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.text: It leaves the list, the totals and the account pickers. Its transactions stay in the lists and reports, and you can restore it from Archived.
archive.stillHas: It still has {{amount}}. Archived, that money is no longer in the {{currency}} total.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.text: It’s removed from Pup Budget for good. This can’t be undone.
delete.stillHas: It still has {{amount}}. That money leaves the {{currency}} total.
